verdict.rationale: Docs describe tasks with a continuing history and comment threads, live multiplayer prompt drafting, and asking the session agent to take further actions like opening a draft PR, implying some ability to interact with a running session, but there is no explicit documentation of sending arbitrary follow-up instructions to steer an in-progress agent session without restarting it. missing for 10: explicit docs on mid-session follow-up/steering commands, hands-on or community confirmation that steering works without restart.
